name: Simplify
description: Simplifies the user interface by hiding particular fields.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 Simplify allows particular fields to be hidden from the user interface. This helps to de-clutter forms and present a more user-friendly experience to content editors.

 Back to top 

 Supported fields 
 Currently the following fields can be hidden:

 
 Nodes 
 Authoring information

Book outline

Comment settings

Menu settings

Publishing options

Revision information

Text format selection

URL path settings

 Domain access 

 Entity translation 

 Node noindex 

 Meta tags 

 URL redirects 

 XML sitemap 
 Blocks 
 Text format selection 
 Comments 
 Text format selection 
 
 
 Users 
 Administrative overlay

Contact settings

Status (blocked/active)

Text format selection

 Meta tags 

 URL redirects 
 Taxonomy 
 Relations

Text format selection

URL alias

 Meta tags 

 URL redirects 

 XML sitemap 
 Profiles 
 Text format selection 
 
 Back to top 

 Versions 
 D8+ and 2.x 
 Simplify module is ported to D8 by Dom. See related issue for current status, roadmap and feature request:

[#2501637]

 7.x-3.x 
 The 3.x version is a complete rewrite of the original Simplify module and is recommended for all users. It will receive bug fixes and new features as they become available.

 7.x-2.x 
 The 2.x version is the original Simplify module written by markoshust. It will only receive bug fixes in future. All users are recommended to upgrade to 3.x and run update.php.

 D6 
 Simplify does not support Drupal 6. Instead, try the Simplify Node Add module which provides similar functionality for node add forms.

 Backdrop 
 Simplify has been ported to Backdrop! and is available here: https://github.com/backdrop-contrib/simplify
